sections.heading: A — Kansas laws and rules
sections.markdown:
## A — Kansas laws and rules

Issuer: Kansas Department of Revenue, Division of Vehicles, publishes this non-commercial driver handbook; the department is identified in the introductory message [A02].
Edition: the cover labels this Kansas Driving Handbook as Revised February 2022 [A01].
Exam: the handbook describes a knowledge test using multiple-choice questions about signs, markings, Kansas law and safe driving [A94].
The handbook states a question count of 25, an 80 percent passing standard, and an untimed test; the usual completion estimate is not a deadline [A94].
This dossier covers Kansas laws and rules; its learning sequence and pedagogic emphasis are product choices, not an official topic weighting.
Effective date and total question-bank size remain unconfirmed (verify sec02-EFFECTIVE, sec02-BANK).

sections.heading: B — Kansas laws and rules
sections.markdown:
## B — Kansas laws and rules

Audience: first-time Kansas non-commercial Class C applicants studying Kansas laws and rules.
The selected scope excludes motorcycle and commercial licensing; those require their own manuals [A11].
Prerequisites and sequence: Recognize traffic controls before comparing speed, yielding, passing and stopping decisions. This is an editorial teaching order, with no claimed official domain weights.
Coverage follows the mapped handbook pages and preserves restrictions, exceptions and decision conditions in separate fact blocks.

sections.heading: C — Kansas laws and rules
sections.markdown:
## C — Kansas laws and rules

FACT_ID: sec02-F01 | anchor: A16
Kansas requires a driving speed that is reasonable for the conditions present. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-F02 | anchor: A16
Choose speed after considering road conditions, weather, the vehicle and your physical condition. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-F03 | anchor: A16
The listed normal-condition maximums do not remove the need to reduce speed for special hazards. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-F04 | anchor: A16
Unless a different limit is posted, an urban district has a maximum speed of 30 miles per hour. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-F05 | anchor: A16
A separated multilane highway designated and posted by the transportation secretary may have a 75-mile-per-hour maximum. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-F06 | anchor: A16
Unless posted otherwise, the maximum on a state or federal highway is 65 miles per hour. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-F07 | anchor: A16
Unless posted otherwise, a county or township road has a 55-mile-per-hour maximum. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-F08 | anchor: A16
A properly marked school zone has a 20-mile-per-hour maximum unless posted otherwise. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-F09 | anchor: A16
A properly marked business district has a 20-mile-per-hour maximum unless posted otherwise. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-F10 | anchor: A16
A school bus follows the posted speed limit unless school-district policy determines otherwise. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-F11 | anchor: A16
Driving below a posted minimum is unlawful under normal road, weather and traffic conditions. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-F12 | anchor: A16
Unnecessarily slow driving that blocks normal traffic is unlawful even without a posted minimum. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-F13 | anchor: A16
A slower speed remains permissible when safe operation under the basic speed rule requires it. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-F14 | anchor: A16
Kansas requires passenger-vehicle occupants to use safety restraints. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-F15 | anchor: A16
An officer may stop a vehicle solely for seeing an unbelted adult in a front seat. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-F16 | anchor: A16
An officer may stop a vehicle solely for seeing an unrestrained child in any seating position. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-F17 | anchor: A16
The passenger-car driver is responsible for providing appropriate restraints for children riding in the car. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-F18 | anchor: A16
The cited restraint rule defines a passenger car as a vehicle built for fewer than 10 passengers. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-F19 | anchor: A16
Children younger than 4 must ride in a federally approved child safety seat. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-F20 | anchor: A16
The handbook requires a seat belt for children aged 8 or older. [A16]
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-F21 | anchor: A17
The handbook identifies the center position in the rear seat as the safest safety-seat location. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F22 | anchor: A17
Install and use a child safety seat according to its manufacturer's instructions. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F23 | anchor: A17
Before slowing, turning or changing lanes, check that the movement can be made safely. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F24 | anchor: A17
Use a signal to tell drivers, cyclists and pedestrians your intended movement. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F25 | anchor: A17
Give the required signal at least 100 feet before the movement or turn. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F26 | anchor: A17
Keep a turn signal operating until you are ready to turn. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F27 | anchor: A17
A vehicle required to have electric turn signals must use them to indicate a turn. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F28 | anchor: A17
Before turning right from a divided four-lane highway, move into the right lane early. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F29 | anchor: A17
Turn right tightly into the right lane of the street you are entering. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F30 | anchor: A17
Begin a left turn from the inside lane near the center line or divider. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F31 | anchor: A17
Complete a left turn just right of the receiving street's center line without swinging wide. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F32 | anchor: A17
Signs or pavement arrows may authorize turns from multiple lanes. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F33 | anchor: A17
Do not make a U-turn on a curve or near a hilltop. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F34 | anchor: A17
A U-turn is prohibited where other drivers cannot see your vehicle from at least 500 feet away. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F35 | anchor: A17
Follow local ordinances and regulatory signs controlling U-turns. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F36 | anchor: A17
On a two-way road with two lanes, a left-side pass requires a safe gap and compliance with the speed limit. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F37 | anchor: A17
Before passing, check ahead for room and behind for another driver beginning to pass. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

Misconceptions: A posted maximum does not make that speed appropriate in poor conditions; the basic speed rule still applies.
Mnemonics: Editorial cue: conditions, clearance, signal, space; use these words to retrieve the cited decisions without inventing a rule.
Glossary: Basic speed means speed suited to conditions; the fact blocks distinguish passing, yielding, stopping and parking.
Dynamic facts: Legal clearances and speed limits belong to this edition and require issuer refresh when changed; local signs and ordinances govern location-specific conditions.

sections.heading: C — Kansas laws and rules
sections.markdown:
## C — Kansas laws and rules

FACT_ID: sec02-F38 | anchor: A17
Use the left signal before starting a pass. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F39 | anchor: A17
After passing, signal right before returning to your normal lane. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F40 | anchor: A17
Return right after a pass only when the entire front of the passed vehicle appears in your inside mirror. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F41 | anchor: A17
When another vehicle passes you, stay in your lane without accelerating. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F42 | anchor: A17
Do not pass within 100 feet of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel when the view is obstructed. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F43 | anchor: A17
Do not pass within 100 feet of an intersection. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F44 | anchor: A17
Do not pass within 100 feet of a railroad grade crossing. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F45 | anchor: A17
Do not pass in a hill, curve or other designated no-passing area. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F46 | anchor: A17
Do not pass when the left side ahead lacks a clear view and freedom from oncoming traffic. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F47 | anchor: A17
Do not pass where a sign forbids it. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F48 | anchor: A17
A solid yellow center marking on your side prohibits passing. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F49 | anchor: A17
Do not pass within 100 feet of a roadside emergency vehicle stopped with emergency lights operating. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F50 | anchor: A17
The pennant-shaped warning sign marks the start of a no-passing area from the left roadside. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F51 | anchor: A17
Double solid yellow center lines prohibit traffic from either direction from crossing them. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F52 | anchor: A17
Finish a pass and return to your lane before an oncoming vehicle is within 200 feet. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

sections.heading: C2 — Kansas laws and rules
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Kansas laws and rules

FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: A17
Passing on the right is permitted on a one-way road marked with at least two lanes traveling in the same direction. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: A17
Do not use the shoulder to pass except for an emergency or instructions from traffic authorities. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: A17
Check ahead and behind and signal before passing on the right. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A17
Following distance must be reasonable for weather, roadway and traffic conditions. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: A17
Leave enough following space to stop or turn if the vehicle ahead stops abruptly. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-R06 | anchor: A17
The handbook uses a two-second following interval for ideal conditions. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-R07 | anchor: A17
The handbook uses a four-second following interval when conditions are adverse. [A17]
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-R08 | anchor: A18
Increase the following gap behind vehicles likely to stop frequently or turn abruptly. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R09 | anchor: A18
Poor weather calls for an even greater following gap. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R10 | anchor: A18
Following too closely limits the view of traffic and road conditions ahead. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R11 | anchor: A18
At a stop sign, stop at the marked stop line when one is present. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R12 | anchor: A18
Without a stop line, stop before the near-side crosswalk, or nearest the intersecting roadway if no crosswalk exists. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R13 | anchor: A18
Stop when leaving an alley, private drive or building in a residential or business area. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R14 | anchor: A18
Stop when a school crossing guard holds the official flag in the stop position. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R15 | anchor: A18
Stop when directed by a railroad-crossing flagger or control device. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R16 | anchor: A18
Stop when a construction flagger directs you to do so. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R17 | anchor: A18
Stop whenever a police officer directs you to stop. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R18 | anchor: A18
For an approaching emergency vehicle using flashing red lights or a siren, pull right and stop clear of intersections. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R19 | anchor: A18
A flashing red traffic light requires a complete stop. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R20 | anchor: A18
Drivers meeting or overtaking a school, church or day-care bus stopped for children must stop. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R21 | anchor: A18
Remain stopped for a children's bus until its stop signal retracts and its red lights go out. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R22 | anchor: A18
Traffic on the opposing roadway of a divided highway need not stop for the bus. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R23 | anchor: A18
Yield to a vehicle that has already entered the intersection from another road. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R24 | anchor: A18
If vehicles arrive from different roads at about the same time, the driver on the left yields to the right-hand driver. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R25 | anchor: A18
At an uncontrolled intersection, yield to the vehicle on your right. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R26 | anchor: A18
At a stop-controlled entrance to a through road, stop and enter only without interfering with traffic. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R27 | anchor: A18
An emergency vehicle using a forward red light or a siren or bell has priority. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R28 | anchor: A18
Stay stopped to the right until the emergency vehicle passes. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R29 | anchor: A18
Do not follow an emergency vehicle responding with warning signals. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R30 | anchor: A18
When approaching a stopped emergency vehicle from behind on a road with at least two lanes each way, cautiously move out of the adjacent lane. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R31 | anchor: A18
If changing lanes beside a stopped emergency vehicle is impossible, slow down and proceed cautiously. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R32 | anchor: A18
Yield to construction workers and vehicles actively working on the road. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R33 | anchor: A18
Move to a lane away from a construction vehicle working on the roadway. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R34 | anchor: A18
A left-turning driver yields to oncoming traffic. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R35 | anchor: A18
When a left-turning vehicle and a straight-moving vehicle enter together, the straight-moving vehicle has priority. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R36 | anchor: A18
A vehicle entering from a private drive or side road yields to traffic on the public roadway. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R37 | anchor: A18
Before crossing a sidewalk from an alley or driveway in a business or residential district, stop and then yield. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R38 | anchor: A18
At a yield sign, stop only when needed to avoid interfering with priority traffic or pedestrians. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R39 | anchor: A18
Do not enter an intersection, crosswalk or railroad crossing without space beyond it for your vehicle. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R40 | anchor: A18
A green signal does not permit entering an intersection that lacks room beyond it. [A18]
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-R41 | anchor: A19
Parking inside an intersection is prohibited. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R42 | anchor: A19
Parking in an intersection crosswalk is prohibited. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R43 | anchor: A19
Do not park within 15 feet of a fire hydrant. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R44 | anchor: A19
Do not park with the vehicle more than 12 inches from the curb. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-R45 | anchor: A19
Parking in front of a driveway is prohibited. [A19]
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-ks-c:kansas-department-of-revenue-division-of:handbook:pdf-0019]
